mission: Complete the Outer Rim survey while investigating the emerging correlation between the wrongness and anomalous ruins on specific worlds.
why_now: The survey route puts Ben on worlds where the wrongness correlates with specific anomalous ruins. The pattern is emerging and his training compels investigation.
conflict: Ben vs. emerging pattern he can't explain — professional obligation vs. instinct
turning_point: Ben identifies anomalous ruins with unrecognized markings on multiple survey worlds, correlating with the wrongness. Curiosity overrides mission parameters.
setting: Multiple Outer Rim survey worlds; aboard Steady Returns
notes: Ben identifies wrongness correlating with specific worlds. Finds anomalous ruins with unrecognized markings. Curiosity overriding mission parameters.
